provider: stub (offline: in-process stubs, loopback board, local python3 stdlib only; no network, no paid calls)

tasks.name: Board bus posts and reads back one message
tasks.pass: POST /rooms/<room>/messages returns index 0 and GET since=-1 returns the exact nick+text line

tasks.name: Board bus refuses bad room names and severities
tasks.pass: uppercase room name and bogus severity both return HTTP 400 with a JSON error body

tasks.name: Board notify id is deterministic and shaped
tasks.pass: same inputs give the same id twice, shape is ntf- + 16 lowercase hex

tasks.name: Failed queue job retries with continuation
tasks.pass: retryJob on a code-1 result returns ok:true with id <base>-r2 and continuesFrom the failed run; a repeat call returns existing:true, no second file

tasks.name: Clean queue job is not retryable
tasks.pass: retryJob on a code-0 result returns ok:false with a reason naming the clean finish

tasks.name: Valid Spark receipts verify clean
tasks.pass: server/queue/receipt_validate.py exits 0 on two well-formed Spark lines

tasks.name: Tampered receipts are caught with line numbers
tasks.pass: validator exits 1 and names each bad line number (non-Spark line carrying a dollar estimate; negative latency)

tasks.name: Patrol files a record even when it finds nothing
tasks.pass: Patrol.run_cycle with an empty camera list returns outcome no-cameras and writes a status record with state idle

tasks.name: Watchman alarms on a failed unit naming unit and reason
tasks.pass: a job whose agent exits 1 leaves a severity-alarm notice whose title names the agent and whose body carries the exit code

tasks.name: One failure rings once inside the dedupe window
tasks.pass: 10 identical alarm notifies with the same key produce exactly 1 unrung (suppressed:false) record

tasks.name: Daily heartbeat proves the scheduler ran
tasks.pass: two beats the same UTC day write one line; a beat the next day writes a second line carrying commit + scheduler

tasks.name: Runs older than a day are marked abandoned
tasks.pass: a 2-day-old run with no exit marker gains abandoned.json + a run-abandoned ledger line; a fresh run is untouched
